# cr-ci teardown.sh (dry-run) project=example-project region=us-central1
# dry-run: nothing is changed; '?' lines are read-only checks, assumed to find nothing
# reconciler cr-runner-reconciler
? gcloud scheduler jobs describe cr-runner-reconciler --location=us-central1 --project=example-project '--format=value(name)'
+ gcloud scheduler jobs delete cr-runner-reconciler --location=us-central1 --project=example-project --quiet
# mediator service cr-runner-mediator
? gcloud run services describe cr-runner-mediator --region=us-central1 --project=example-project '--format=value(metadata.name)'
+ gcloud run services delete cr-runner-mediator --region=us-central1 --project=example-project --quiet
# runner job cr-gh-runner-8c32g
? gcloud run jobs describe cr-gh-runner-8c32g --region=us-central1 --project=example-project '--format=value(name)'
+ gcloud run jobs delete cr-gh-runner-8c32g --region=us-central1 --project=example-project --quiet
# repository cr-runners and its images
? gcloud artifacts repositories describe cr-runners --location=us-central1 --project=example-project '--format=value(name)'
+ gcloud artifacts repositories delete cr-runners --location=us-central1 --project=example-project --quiet
# secret cr-runner-gh-app-private-key
? gcloud secrets describe cr-runner-gh-app-private-key --project=example-project '--format=value(name)'
+ gcloud secrets delete cr-runner-gh-app-private-key --project=example-project --quiet
# secret cr-runner-gh-webhook-secret
? gcloud secrets describe cr-runner-gh-webhook-secret --project=example-project '--format=value(name)'
+ gcloud secrets delete cr-runner-gh-webhook-secret --project=example-project --quiet
# project binding of BUILD_SA_NAME (logging.logWriter)
+ gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding example-project --member=serviceAccount:cr-runner-build-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --role=roles/logging.logWriter --condition=None --format=none
# service account cr-runner-exec-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
? gcloud iam service-accounts describe cr-runner-exec-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=example-project '--format=value(email)'
+ gcloud iam service-accounts delete cr-runner-exec-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=example-project --quiet
# service account cr-runner-scheduler-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
? gcloud iam service-accounts describe cr-runner-scheduler-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=example-project '--format=value(email)'
+ gcloud iam service-accounts delete cr-runner-scheduler-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=example-project --quiet
# service account cr-runner-mediator-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
? gcloud iam service-accounts describe cr-runner-mediator-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=example-project '--format=value(email)'
+ gcloud iam service-accounts delete cr-runner-mediator-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=example-project --quiet
# service account cr-runner-build-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
? gcloud iam service-accounts describe cr-runner-build-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=example-project '--format=value(email)'
+ gcloud iam service-accounts delete cr-runner-build-sa@example-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com --project=example-project --quiet
# done; APIs were left enabled
